assets.name: controller
assets.prompt: Edit the attached tiny Super Mario Sunshine menu icon into a SECOND ANIMATION FRAME of the SAME icon. This is an actual game sprite, not a mockup. Subject: the purple GameCube controller: subtly tilt the two control sticks and rotate the controller a few degrees for an alternate resting pose; keep its purple shell and colored buttons. Preserve exact recognizable original silhouette proportions, original palette, thick black outline, simple painted cartoon shading and rough low-resolution Nintendo GameCube-era sprite feel. One isolated icon only, centered with ample transparent padding. No background, no letters added, no border or label, no other objects. The change should be clearly an alternate drawn pose, not only translating the whole image. Preserve the source style very closely. Output a square transparent PNG with the complete icon visible. This will be reduced to about 34 pixels high and alternated with the original every half second.
